integrity_rules: Never modify, normalize, spell-correct, or relocate an explicit PF feedback value except as part of moving its complete company block.
A company name must occur in exactly one contiguous block.
The final row in every company block must be its company-summary row.
The summary count in column B must equal the number of preceding target-person rows in that block.
Each target-person row must have a unique normalized Company plus Target Person pair.
Each target-person row must have at least one named mutual contact in D, F, H, J, or L.
A mutual-note cell must not be populated when its paired mutual-name cell is blank.
The same normalized mutual contact must not appear twice on one target-person row.
The permanent NEW COMPANY INSERTION POINT marker follows the last company block and must move down atomically when the data region grows.
Every new company is inserted as one complete contiguous block immediately above the marker; the marker is never overwritten, deleted, or bypassed.

The spacer and premium summary remain immediately below the marker and move down with it; the summary title, executive statement, ten metric rows, and How-to-use text must stay synchronized with current counts.
A1:Y headers, merged ranges, column widths, row-height policy, colours, validations, banding, and conditional formats must not drift during content edits.
Every populated cell in A6:Y375 is vertically top-aligned and every affected data row is fitted to its wrapped content after an edit.
Search!A8 must read the complete Warm Paths data region and the Search grid and banding must be tall enough for the maximum spill result.
Column Z on Warm Paths remains blank and reserved.
The Sam Dharmasiri tab contains exactly 149 unique target rows in 126 contiguous company blocks, and every target row has Sam Dharmasiri in Mutual 1.
The Sam Dharmasiri tab is independent of Search and Warm Paths; changes to it must not alter either existing tab unless a later reviewed schema explicitly authorizes that dependency.
The Jeremy Pike tab contains exactly 60 unique target rows in 48 contiguous company blocks, and every target row has Jeremy Pike in Mutual 1.
The Jeremy Pike tab is independent of Search, Warm Paths, and Sam Dharmasiri; changes to it must not alter those existing tabs unless a later reviewed schema explicitly authorizes that dependency.
The Prasath Nanayakkara tab contains exactly 20 unique target rows in 19 contiguous company blocks, and every target row has Prasath Nanayakkara in Mutual 1.

The Prasath Nanayakkara tab is independent of Search, Warm Paths, Sam Dharmasiri, and Jeremy Pike; changes to it must not alter those existing tabs unless a later reviewed schema explicitly authorizes that dependency.
The Former Clients tab contains an expandable A:Y route tracker and the complete consolidated published 1BT relationship register in AC:AN; Z:AB remains blank.

Every Former Clients prospect block contains one to five eligible senior target rows followed by exactly one company-summary row, every target has at least one target-specific named mutual route, and the complete block has no more than five distinct named introducers.

Only high-confidence direct clients and testimonial clients may be named Former Clients Sales Navigator seeds; products, partners, PoCs, ambiguous items and anonymized cases remain non-seed register records.
Former Clients is independent of Search and every earlier tab; Search must not reference it and changes to it must not alter any existing tab.
Former Clients scores and change proxies are propensity evidence only and must never be presented as confirmed, active or verified opportunities.
change_protocol: Read this contract and docs/northwind_warm_paths_sheet_contract.md before every edit.

Before editing the Sam Dharmasiri tab, also read docs/northwind_sam_dharmasiri_sheet_contract.md and docs/northwind_sam_dharmasiri_sheet_contract.v1.json; those files are normative for the complete tab schema.

Before editing the Jeremy Pike tab, also read docs/northwind_jeremy_pike_sheet_contract.md and docs/northwind_jeremy_pike_sheet_contract.v1.json; those files are normative for the complete tab schema.

Before editing the Former Clients tab, also read docs/northwind_former_clients_sheet_contract.md and docs/northwind_former_clients_sheet_contract.v1.json; those files are normative for the complete tab schema.
Create a dated Drive copy of the entire workbook before changing rows, formats, formulas, or dimensions.
Read metadata and the exact affected CellData immediately before writing.
Never use a values-only append for populated company data; copy the complete native row structure and overwrite only planned row-specific fields.
Use insertDimension immediately above the permanent insertion marker to create enough rows for the complete new company block; do not type over the marker or append below it.
Insert or move complete company blocks only; never sort individual rows across company boundaries.
After changing wrapped content, use autoResizeDimensions only on the affected populated rows; never apply a fixed 21 px height to the data region.

When the data region changes, update the Warm Paths banding, Y conditional-format ranges, Search formula source range, Search spill capacity, insertion-marker and summary positions, displayed counts, percentages, averages, and this contract in the same controlled change.

After writing, prove that all non-targeted values and user-entered formats are byte-for-byte unchanged, all PF feedback is exact, every company is contiguous, all counts reconcile, and the rendered sheet has no format boundary.
